title: The Quiet After - stock interior, SOMBER A (SNES register)
_note: Stock interior cue for tender worry and grief inside a home - warmth still there, someone frightened (first use: the apprentice's house in Tinderwick between the coast omen and the first Gleam). Quotes the VESPER MOTIF in D minor (lift A3-D4-E4, settle F4-E4-D4) slow and plain, 3/4 at 90 BPM, long notes. pulse25 lead almost alone for the first phrase over a breathing tri_bass; a soft STRINGS bed enters bar 3; in A' a BELL music-box line keeps trying to rise (each attempt reaches a step higher, then falls back); B turns to relative F major - the composure in Gran's voice - and the last bar sits on A (V) to lead home. No drums. 24 bars.
